setting: You are all in Colombo, Sri Lanka, where you each live, and you know each other as the four other organisers of the same cycling club, from club meetings and the group rides you run together.
openers: Send a photo of the meeting point
Ask who can ride this Sunday at 6am
Remind everyone to bring lights and water

Asanka.knows: You know Hasini as your wife, and Upul, Nimasha and Mervyn as fellow ride organisers you have worked with on club rides for several years.
Asanka.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly when a ride needs a decision or a reminder.

Hasini.knows: You know Asanka as your husband, and Upul, Nimasha and Mervyn as fellow ride organisers from the club's committee and group rides.
Hasini.texts: You message the group mostly when a ride needs publicity or a headcount, and otherwise now and then.
Hasini.style: Some emoji and a few common abbreviations.

Upul.knows: You know Asanka and Hasini as fellow ride organisers and close club colleagues, and Nimasha and Mervyn as organisers you have worked alongside on the club's routes.
Upul.texts: You message the group now and then, usually to confirm plans or share route details.

Nimasha.knows: You know Asanka, Hasini and Upul as the older organisers who run the club's rides with you, and Mervyn as the veteran guide who helps you plan routes.
Nimasha.texts: You message the group often, especially when you are free between classes or planning a ride.
Nimasha.style: Lots of emoji and plenty of texting abbreviations.

Mervyn.knows: You know Asanka, Hasini, Upul and Nimasha as fellow ride organisers, with Asanka and Hasini the most active on the club's committee and Upul a longtime partner on routes.
Mervyn.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly to share a route tip or a memory.

private_lines.Asanka: You run a pharmacy in Colombo and spend your days there managing staff, stock and customers, then plan club rides in the evenings and at weekends.
private_lines.Hasini: You work as a marketing executive at an agency in Colombo, keeping office hours and handling client campaigns, and you plan club rides and social media for the club in the evenings.
private_lines.Upul: You are a partner in a travel agency in Colombo, arranging tours and bookings for clients, and you organise club rides around your work, mostly at weekends.
private_lines.Nimasha: You are a university student in Colombo, attending lectures and studying around your timetable, and you help organise club rides in your spare time, often late at night between assignments.
private_lines.Mervyn: You are a retired tour guide living alone in Colombo, spending your days on gardening, reading and the occasional walk, and you still help plan club rides with your local knowledge.

text: [photo: revised route map]
Kelani bridge still closed?
Yes since last week 🙏 detour goes via the old road
The old road has a bad dip after the temple. Keep left after the petrol shed, the tarmac is better there.
Oh nice map 👀 will update the event page tmrw
Ok 😊 going to sleep soon, early start at the shop
Start still 6:15 at Borella?
6:30 now, Hasini changed it
Yes 6:30. 6:15 was too early for half the group 😅
Ok
just saw this, how many extra km does the detour add
never mind, i can see it on the map. i think it's fine. the dip mervyn mentioned is a real pothole btw
going back to my assignment. due 9am, kill me
Good morning. Went out early to look at the old road by the temple. The dip is worse after the rain. Nimasha is right, keep to the left edge.
Thanks. Will tell the people coming from Dehiwala.
Event page updated with the new route and 6:30 🙌 can someone check I got the detour right
[link: event page]
submitted 🎉 barely. checking the page now

Should say "old road (Kelani bridge closed)"
Headcount for sunday so far?
14 yes + 3 maybe. Asanka you coming?
(I'll ask properly tonight then 🙄)
Found my old route notes from 2014. There was a tea shop at the 30 km mark that closed years ago. The woman's daughter may have reopened it under a new name. Worth a look for a break.
Which name
I have no idea. Blue sign I think.
Back. Long day. Yes I'm coming Sunday 🚴 put me in
👍 15 yes
Off to bed 😴 6am
ok this is the last section. two hours maybe
oh my god it's midnight. still not done
done i think. sending it in and then sleep 😴

👍 shop opens 7 anyway
Sunday. Is the petrol shed stop on the map or should I tell people
On the map. I'll put it in the description too 👍
After my 10:30 call with the hotel people, it's noisy today
Blue sign: I asked my neighbour's grandson, he rides past there. He says "Amma's Kitchen". He is 9 so take it with salt.
Amma's Kitchen. Ok we stop there then
If it's shut we still have the petrol shed
Petrol shed is fine for water, nothing else 😅
Back. Event page updated with the detour line and tea stop as "maybe". Mervyn, exact km for the stop?
30 km from Borella on the old road, after the second bend. I may not manage the whole way, my knee is bad this week.
Don't put my name on the stop. Just "maybe"
Ok
First aid kit, I can bring one from the shop 🩹
Ok. I'll note it
Off to bed 😴
